items.title: Terry Gibbs interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2001 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: There would always be Count Basie, Sarah Vaughan, Terry Gibbs, Duke Ellington, Dinah Washington, Terry Gibbs.

ctx.x: My name is Monk Rowe and we are in New York City. I’m pleased to have the opportunity to speak with Terry Gibbs here, who just described himself as a hero of New York.

I’m a hero. I grew up in New York and it’s very fortunate, I really did well in New York. I was accepted royally. I was the house band leader at Birdland in my younger days. There would always be Count Basie, Sarah Vaughan, Terry Gibbs, Duke Ellington, Dinah Washington, Terry Gibbs. But I was there six months a year, and I’d be on the road the other six months. But I was always accepted and it was great. I got a chance to play with everybody in the world.
Was it here where you won the Major Bowes contest?

items.title: Terry Gibbs interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 5, 2021 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: It was always Count Basie, Sarah Vaughn, Terry Gibbs; Duke Ellington, Dinah Washington, Terry Gibbs.

ctx.x: they said, “Okay we want you, it’s your job, but Steve Allen had a nine piece orchestra, we’ll give you a nine piece orchestra.” I said, “I don’t want it.” They said, “Well what do you mean?” I said, “You mean they give me a big band because we’re opposite Johnny Carson? Or opposite Elliot Lawrence who was with Les Crane — those shows at that time they all had 16 piece bands. And to me a 16 piece band — give me a sextet. I said sextet? Can you make it with a sextet? You see working with Steve Allen, of course I…

in at Letter D, the ending.” Play the intro — the singer never knew we never played the middle. We’d never do it. So that’s what I learned. So I did that for my TV shows, and then, you know it was, it just came naturally to me because the harder part got later on. See all the talent we had for the first maybe two or three weeks, and that’s why Regis, in last, where all the talent that already were booked for Steve Allen. And Steve was a big jazz fan so he’d have Sarah Vaughan, Stan Getz, Oscar Peterson, Count…
